column4: Chinese 太少了 uses 太 ("too"), like 太热了/太大了 nearby which are all glossed with "demasiado"; "muy poco" only means "very little", losing the excessive/insufficient sense
Amar reads stiff/anglicized applied to food; a native speaker says "me encanta" for things one loves (amar is for people, as correctly used in p241 for family)
Same issue as p300: "amar" plus inanimate object/activity is unnatural register; "encantar" is the natural equivalent
Same issue as p300: unnatural to say "amo leer" in casual neutral Spanish; "me encanta leer" is what a native speaker says
Same issue as p300: "amo dormir" is stiff/calque-like; "me encanta dormir" is the natural phrase
Same issue as p300: "amo comer" is unnatural register for a casual line; "me encanta comer" is natural
